epoch_comparability: v5 epochs come from ONE continuous run saved at each epoch boundary (finetune_lora.py --save-epoch-adapters). the linear LR schedule decays across the whole 3-epoch horizon, so a v5 epoch-1 or epoch-2 checkpoint is NOT directly comparable to v4's separately trained epoch-1 and epoch-2 families, which each decayed over their own shorter horizon. compare v5 epochs with each other, and compare v4 against v5 only at the final selected checkpoint
